Buffalo Tofu
By: Lord Of The Wings
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 12:44am

Ingredients




Extra firm tofu

Corn starch

Garlic Powder

Cayenne Pepper

Buffalo Hot Sauce (hot pepper sauce & 
Preparation

1 Press tofu to remove moisture (place a weight on top). 2 Cut into strips, cubes, wing shapes - whatever you want - just keep it thin. 3 Toss strips in cornstarch, then garlic powder. 4 Deep fry for 1-2 minutes until crispy. 5 While deep frying, mix ingredients for hot sauce and bring to a simmer in a pot. 6 Remove, pat with paper towel. 7 In a bowl, sprinkle on cayenne pepper. 8 Pour sauce over tofu 'wings' and eat immediately.
